acceptanceRules: Search matches partial queries across every user-visible work-item field.
The All status selection includes every workflow status.
Risk scoring preserves due-today urgency and blocked-item weighting.
Summary metrics count both blocked and escalated work.
The queue shows every matching item unless pagination is explicitly introduced.
Stored sessions tolerate missing or damaged browser state.
Approval requires an approver role and complete evidence; note text is not authorization.
The helper returns due-date order without mutating its input array.
